name: Iconics
rootCause: Iconics, an NFT project on Solana, was accused of being a “Rug pull.” The 17-year-old artist behind Iconics made about $140,000 before disappearing. The project developers also deleted Iconics’ Twitter account and disabled Discord channel chat.
